phase7_constraint_carryforward.evidence: review/analysis-premortem.json null_falsification_table (H1-H5) and reporting_depth_checklist read; decision rules DR-01..DR-06 evaluated against executed results (see decision_rule_outcomes)

decision_rule_outcomes.DR-01: triggered: H5 reported as no detectable narrowing
decision_rule_outcomes.DR-03: triggered for geothermal (26 identifying cells): describe as imprecise

findings: All 20 registry rows have finite estimates, nonnegative SEs, and p-values in [0, 1].
Stage-1 cross-check: 31/31 table cells (estimate and SE at 3 dp) match the registry and model estimates across Tables 2, 3, and A1.
Headline S03: -0.122 (SE 0.021), about an 11.5% lower mean hourly wage for the same occupation and year; two-way clustered SE 0.028 (p about 0.0001) per se-sensitivity.csv, so DR-04 is not triggered.
S11-S20 all negative and significant; the S03 magnitude ranges from -0.10 (S15 fossil-only; S19 leave-out-biomass) to -0.17 (S16 hydro excluded). No sign reversal, so DR-06 is not triggered.
S15 renewable vs fossil-only is -0.101 with a CI excluding 0, so DR-02 is not triggered: the gap is not just a nuclear premium.
S20 balanced-set 2025 gap of -0.131 matches S06, so the trend result is not driven by occupation coverage.
2,096 detailed cells; 1,876 analytic (excluded: 'other' generation, suppressed wages/employment, top-coded means). Occupation-years: 780, mixed: 335.
Identifying cells sharing occupation-years with fossil fuel: geothermal 26, biomass 61. Geothermal is below the DR-03 threshold of 30, so describe it as imprecise.
P90 censoring: 1,307 of 1,577 cells retained in S10; reported as conditional.
H1 supported; H3 supported (nuclear positive, hydro null, solar and wind negative); H4 supported (joint F about 29, p < 0.001; production -18%, professional -2% n.s.).
H2 not supported as stated: composition does not account for the gap (composition about +0.02 log points); the gap is within occupation plus non-overlapping occupations.
H5 not supported: no narrowing (S07 -0.005/yr, n.s.). Apply DR-01 and DR-05: no causal or policy attribution.

result_interpretation.direction_summary: Renewable generation industries pay less than fossil and nuclear for the same occupation and year (S03 -0.122). Nuclear pays more and hydro about the same as fossil fuel; solar, wind, geothermal, and biomass pay less. Gaps are largest in production and maintenance occupations. There is no narrowing 2021-2025.
result_interpretation.strength_summary: Headline is about an 11.5% lower mean hourly wage (95% CI about -7.7% to -15.1% in percent terms); stable across 10 robustness specifications (-0.10 to -0.17 log points).
result_interpretation.uncertainty_summary: Occupation-clustered SE 0.021; industry-year 0.024; two-way 0.028. Year-specific estimates overlap; trend not distinguishable from zero.
claim_constraints: H2 and H5 reported as not supported
P90 gap conditional on uncensored cells

robustness_assessment.interpretation_implications: Headline sign and approximate magnitude survive weighting, outcome, sample, categorization, and clustering choices; magnitude is smallest without nuclear or biomass (about -0.10) and largest without hydro (about -0.17).
